messages.subject: Creation of a reactive object with condition
parts:
Dear all,

I try to create a reactive object with depends on actionButton pressed. The object will be a file (with a choose.file or with a R6 class object)

However, I have many problems to manage to do it (I simpified the code to be more efficient).

1) The simplest code I write :


runApp(list(
  ui = fluidPage(
    actionButton("create", "create"),
    actionButton("load", "load")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
   
  

      currentProject <- reactive({
         
          input$create
          input$load
            if (input$load!=0) {"load"}
            if (input$create!=0) {"create"}
         
         
       
        })
     
    observe({
      input$create
      input$load
      print(currentProject())
    })
  }
))

did not work because the result remains always the same ("create")

2) I try to isolate the expression without result :

runApp(list(
  ui = fluidPage(
    actionButton("create", "create"),
    actionButton("load", "load")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
   
   
   
    currentProject <- reactive({
     
      input$create
      input$load
     
      isolate({
        if (input$load!=0) {"load"}
      })
      isolate({
        if (input$create!=0) {"create"}
      })
     
     
     
    })
   
    observe({
      input$create
      input$load
      print(currentProject())
    })
  }
))

same result

3) I tried to separate the two conditiosn but only the last works

runApp(list(
  ui = fluidPage(
    actionButton("create", "create"),
    actionButton("load", "load")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
   
   
   
    currentProject <- reactive({
     
      input$create   

      isolate({
        if (input$create!=0) {"create"}
      })
     
     
     
    })
   
    currentProject <- reactive({
     
      input$load
     
      isolate({
        if (input$load!=0) {"load"}
      }) 
    })
   
   
    observe({
      input$create
      input$load
      print(currentProject())
    })
  }
))

Does anyone have any ideas on how doing this ??

thank you very much in advance !!!

Charlotte
